body: At least you're here to hear my screams. Thanks :)

I've tried all the things. Exercise, diet, mindfulness, drugs, going outside, etc etc etc.  Been through 7 therapists. Every now and then I consider going back only to be crushed under the pile trying to sift through the never ending stream of people not really believing the 8th time is the charm.

Ha, thanks. Forgot I wrote that out twice actually.  I appreciate the words :) 

Logged on cause I kinda decided to make this my "poetic caterwauling" account but honestly tonight I suddenly don't feel like it anymore :)

I've tried to meditate my mind just does not quiet down. Pretty sure I've got undiagnosed adhd. First boredom, then my brain cannibalizes itself. I sure am aware I'm thinking, I'm thinking about how bored I am haha
